description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonProjects, a custom widget for rendering a remove button in project subpanel views within a CRM system (likely SuiteCRM/SugarCRM). The class provides methods to generate HTML for the remove action, with logic to handle permissions and module-specific behaviors.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonProjects
classes.description: A widget class responsible for rendering a remove button in subpanel views for projects, with permission checks and module-specific actions.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space, used as a placeholder header cell in the subpanel.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates the HTML link/button for removing a related record from the project subpanel, including permission and module checks, URL construction, and confirmation prompts.
